text:
Amara Singh: Hi everybody! Started today as a product engineer on the API team. Laptop and headphones arrived, but I can't enroll in MDM (it errors during the cert install). Also can't reach registry.redwood.internal from home. Quick hello — excited to be here! Fun fact: I juggle and make bad latte art. :coffee:

Priya Rao: welcome Amara!! People Ops here. Can you DM me your employee email and preferred t-shirt size? We'll sort the kits.

Amara Singh: Sent DM with email. T-shirt: S (unisex).

Carlos Mendez: Hey Amara, I'm on infra. For the MDM cert error, what macOS version are you on and what's the error message? For registry from home you need corp-VPN.

Amara Singh: macOS 13.6, installer shows "Profile install failed: certificate not trusted". VPN client fails with TLS handshake.

Jenna Park: try the corp CA from the onboarding page first: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/mdm. If that doesn't work, IT Helpdesk can push a temporary profile.

IT Helpdesk: @Amara Singh please run: `sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain ~/Downloads/redwood-ca.crt` then retry MDM enrollment. DM us the output if it still fails.

Amara Singh: ran the command, got "certificate added" — attempting enroll now. Thanks!

Carlos Mendez: once VPN is up, run `curl -I https://registry.redwood.internal/v2/` to verify access. If you get 401, request group access to `api-team` in #eng-infra.

Amara Singh: VPN now connects, curl returns 200 OK. Pulling images works. Also quick onboarding question: who owns the API docs for /v2/models?

Jenna Park: Product docs live in the repo `docs/api` and the canonical reference is in Confluence under API -> Models. Ping me and I'll point you to the PR template.

Priya Rao: welcome pack en route (stickers + socks). People Ops checklist updated. When you're free later today we'll do a 30-min intro with the team.

Amara Singh: Awesome, thanks all. Two truths & a lie: I can juggle five balls, I've run a half-marathon, I hate spicy food. Guess! :grin:

Carlos Mendez: lie is the five balls?

Jenna Park: I'm betting you don't hate spicy food.

Amara Singh: Correct — I can juggle three but not five, and I love spicy food. :sweat_smile: Looking forward to the intro meeting.

People Ops Bot: @Amara Singh added to #new-hires. Onboarding checklist: 3/6 complete.
